pipeline: ui_bangyu_1/ui_bangyu_2 source textures and mixed particle materials
LayaParticleUnlit renders into UIEffectStage ARGB32 RenderTexture
all UIEffectStage channels use the same UIEffectAdditive RawImage material
UIEffectAdditive discards RenderTexture alpha and returns alpha=max(rgb)
Blend One OneMinusSrcAlpha composites the synthetic coverage into Canvas

code_evidence.fact: fragment output alpha is saturate(max(rgb)); sampled RenderTexture alpha is ignored
all channel RawImages receive the same UIEffectAdditive material; channel RT is ARGB32
source materials retain different RGB blend modes, while final UI composite applies one global interpretation

root_cause: The final UI composite conflates RGB luminance with pixel coverage. Transparent pixels with retained gray RGB are converted into nonzero alpha and become visible gray discs. This is independent of the already-correct quantity, size and direction.

web_boundary: The shared composite defect is confirmed. The exact WebGL amplification mechanism is not yet confirmed; capture raw RT RGBA and final Canvas at matched Editor/WebGL timepoints before attributing it to color space or shader precision.
